doc: The stored width of the created dimension is not observable through this pipeline: the case writes the dimension to LAS through `extra_dims`, which names the type it writes, so what is graded here is that the dimension is created, holds the assigned values, and reaches a file under its own name. stages/filters.assign.rst, note under 'Assignment Expressions': 'As of PDAL 2.7.0, assignment to a dimension that does not exist will cause it to be created. It will always be created with type double, however.'  The same page: value 'A list of :ref:`assignment expressions <Assignment Expressions>` to be applied to points. The list of values is evaluated in order.' and 'A ``ValueExpression`` consists of constants, dimension names and mathematical operators that evaluates to a numeric value.'  'type double' is the floating-point width, which an independent laspy readback reports as an 8-byte 'floating' extra dimension.
